modules.module_title: Select and prepare the site for sugarcane cultivation

pcs.pc_description: check the site has conducive climatic conditions for sugarcane cultivation and is free from limiting factors such as flooding, drought, and extreme heat and cold
coordinate with an authorised lab to determine if the soil is suitable for sugarcane cultivation at the site
ensure the site is accessible and has availability of quality water, labour and other inputs required for sugarcane cultivation
create irrigation channels in the field, ensuring uniform levelling and grading of the field for effective drainage
prepare the field for sowing setts according to the terrain, location of planting and the system to be followed such as ridges and furrows, trench, flat system, etc.
apply compost, crop residue and mulch to the field in the recommended quantities
check the soil's pH level using a pH meter and apply lime or gypsum in an appropriate quantity to adjust the pH level

identify the appropriate variety of sugarcane for vegetative propagation depending on the time of sowing, area of cultivation, resistance to smut and red rot, drought tolerance, yield, sucrose or fibre content, etc.
extract the seed material from the recent sugarcane crop, ensuring the buds are not covered with too many dry scales and are free from pests and disease
arrange budded setts in the required number and prepare the setts for planting using the appropriate tools and equipment
treat the sugarcane setts with hot air or aerated steam at the recommended temperature for the prescribed duration to eliminate mosaic virus
prepare the sett treatment solution using the recommended organomercurial chemicals and soak the setts in the solution for the prescribed duration
ascertain the appropriate seeding rate for planting the setts as per the sugarcane varietal recommendations
plant setts in the field maintaining the recommended planting density, and apply appropriate fertilisers in the recommended dose
carry out propping of sugarcane at the recommended interval

modules.module_title: Follow preventive measures to control pests and disease

pcs.pc_description: use pest and disease-resistant varieties of sugarcane
follow the recommended practices to restrict the entry of pathogens into the field through planting material, irrigation water, workers, tools and equipment, and vectors such as whitefly
carry out crop rotation with suitable crops, ensuring timely sowing and hygiene in the field
identify and remove the diseased crop to prevent the spread of pests and diseases to the healthy crop

use the recommended combination of biological, mechanical and chemical control methods for effective pest and disease prevention, such as pheromone traps, light traps, bird perches, sticky traps, as suitable to the cultivar
use egg parasitoids from trichogramma, larval parasitoids microplitis, and sturmiopsis for controlling pests

modules.module_title: Identify pests and disease in the sugarcane crop

pcs.pc_description: check the sugarcane crop and identify different types of pests such as early shoot borer, top shoot borer, internode borer, white grub, termites, woolly aphids, mealy bugs, etc.
conduct regular field visits to identify plant disease vectors and major sugarcane diseases such as wilt, red rot, rust, smut, pokkah boeng, sett rot, ratoon stunting, yellow leaf, etc.
determine the stage of pest incidence along with the extent of damage and economic threshold levels (ETL) of the pests
use Integrated Pest Management (IPM) methods like light and pheromone traps to identify the presence and population of insects and vectors
co-ordinate with the agricultural extension workers and diagnostic clinics to determine the causal organism for the disease and its treatment

modules.module_title: Identify and apply the necessary treatment

pcs.pc_description: follow the appropriate integrated pest management techniques such as trash mulching, de- trashing, pest egg destruction, bund freeing, water draining, usage of bio-control agents, etc.

identify and adopt natural enemies of crop pests such as ladybird, ground beetles, hoverfly for pest control, according to the advice of agricultural extension workers, Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK), agricultural universities etc.
apply the recommended treatment as per the prescription to remove pests and diseases
follow the recommended safety practices while applying any treatment, such as using the relevant PPE
maintain the record of the use of any pesticides, insecticides and any other treatment
optimise the usage of water and other resources in various tasks and processes
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
segregate waste into appropriate categories
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately and dispose the non-recyclable waste in an environment-friendly manner
